listening.title: Interview Question: Handling Conflict in a Team

lines.speaker: Lan (Interviewer)
lines.text: Can you tell me about a time you had a conflict with a teammate?

lines.speaker: Đức (Candidate)
lines.text: Sure. Last year, a colleague and I had a clash over how to prioritize a sprint.

lines.speaker: Đức (Candidate)
lines.text: We didn't see eye to eye — he wanted to focus on new features, and I wanted to fix bugs first.

lines.speaker: Đức (Candidate)
lines.text: I asked for a quick chat to get to the bottom of why we disagreed.

lines.speaker: Lan (Interviewer)
lines.text: Did that help defuse the situation?

lines.speaker: Đức (Candidate)
lines.text: Yes. Once we talked, we found common ground — fixing critical bugs first, then new features.

lines.speaker: Lan (Interviewer)
lines.text: Did you let him air his grievances during that talk?

lines.speaker: Đức (Candidate)
lines.text: Definitely. I think that's why neither of us held a grudge afterward.

lines.speaker: Lan (Interviewer)
lines.text: Did anyone need to mediate, like your manager?

lines.speaker: Đức (Candidate)
lines.text: No, we managed to sort it out between the two of us.
